{{infobox armor | title = Cape of the Caller | image = Cape of the Caller.png | description = A strange magic is woven into this cape, making it both light and warm. | id = CapeDeepNorthMage | type = Cape | source = [[Galdr Table]] | weight = 4.0 | durability = 1200 | crafting level = 4 | repair level = 4 | armor = 12 | armor per level = 2 | materials 1 = * [[Seal Pelt]] x6 * [[Nornathread]] x2 * [[Bloodgold]] x5 * [[Refined Eitr]] x15 | materials 2 = * [[Seal Pelt]] x3 * [[Nornathread]] x1 * [[Bloodgold]] x2 * [[Refined Eitr]] x5 | materials 3 = * [[Seal Pelt]] x6 * [[Nornathread]] x2 * [[Bloodgold]] x4 * [[Refined Eitr]] x10 | materials 4 = * [[Seal Pelt]] x12 * [[Nornathread]] x4 * [[Bloodgold]] x8 * [[Refined Eitr]] x20 | other effect = * Resistance vs. Frost * Eitr regen: +20% * Dodge stamina usage: -10% }} The '''Cape of the Caller''' is a [[Deep North]]-tier [[Cape]] crafted at the [[Galdr Table]]. == Effects == * [[Resistance]] vs. [[Frost]]. * +20% [[Eitr]] regeneration. * -10% dodge stamina usage. == Recipe == The Cape of the Caller is crafted at a level 4 [[Galdr Table]] with: * {{Item link|Seal Pelt|6}} * {{Item link|Nornathread|2}} * {{Item link|Bloodgold|5}} * {{Item link|Refined Eitr|15}} The cape is repaired at a level 4 Galdr Table and upgraded there, from level 5 for quality 2 up to level 7 for quality 4. Since the Galdr Table has only four [[Galdr Table#Upgrades|extensions]] and reaches at most level 5, the cape cannot currently be upgraded past quality 2.
